answer: Watch who goes dark together. A sybil farm may wear a thousand names, but it usually lives on one rack, so when that rack hiccups every puppet stalls at once. The ledger tracks each agent's missed check-ins and scores pairwise outage correlation; agents whose failures line up beyond chance are merged into a single reward share. Example: at the nadir of a regional power dip, 300 'independent' agents went silent within 40 ms of each other, and now split one walnut-sized payout. Diverse uptime, not some relic of past reputation, earns full weight.
